WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        order_count,
        CAST(order_count AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`), 0) AS share
    FROM account_order_counts
),
averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    SUM(s.order_count) AS total_orders,
    AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
    AVG(s.share - a.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE s.share > a.average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Accounts with no orders are included when calculating the average share; each account in the account table contributes one share.
